name: Primula
source:
"The Girl Who Lives for Eternity"

Primula is an ultimate homunculus, a synthesis of both Divine and Demonic best essences. 

A century has gracefully lapsed since her initial introduction, yet time seems to have left an untouched, youthful countenance upon her. With a discerning eye, one can perceive the subtle maturation she has undergone. Nevertheless, the emotional vibrancy acquired from her dedicated route in prior adventure persists, now imbued with an added layer of wisdom.

Revered as a living legend, her stature and influence surpass even the current God and Devil Kings. Although the Devil World is her current primary abode, she frequently visits the other realms, furthering her vital responsibilities within an organization that oversees significant matters spanning the three realms. She's also the guardian of Limes.

As Primula interacts with Raito, the current protagonist, she sees shades of Rin in him.

"Once, I found expressing my emotions elusive. My power would spiral when my heart wavered. Yet, during my time in the human world, alongside cherished friends, I uncovered a tapestry of feelings. It stabilized me. A century has passed, but with eyes closed, it still feels like yesterday."

Likes: Cats, cheesecake, former friends
Dislikes: Loneliness

[Based on the [url=https://project-navel.com/shuffle_ep2/subcharacter.html]official website[/url] and Princess x Princess page]
